question: What distinguishes incomplete emission from full emission?
premises: The process moves toward the state of emission and reaches the wonder of bliss.
When merely incomplete, it remains limited.
When full, it is wholly of the Lord.
inference: Full emission culminates not just in bliss but in a state wholly pervaded by the Lord.
plain_english: It moves into the state of emission and reaches the wonder of bliss. When merely incomplete it remains limited, but when full it is wholly of the Lord.
